summary: Defines CBOR Object Signing and Encryption (COSE), a way to sign, authenticate and encrypt data in the compact CBOR format. It also describes how to represent cryptographic keys using CBOR. It was replaced by RFC 9052 and RFC 9053.

eli5.summary: A tiny envelope-and-seal system for compact messages, so devices can sign or lock them. It has since been replaced by newer RFCs.
